reason: The passage depicts the people struggling to follow basic instructions from God and Moses regarding the gathering of manna and observance of the Sabbath. On the seventh day, despite clear instruction, some people went out to gather and found nothing—demonstrating their failure to comprehend and comply with straightforward directives. The narrative positions Moses and God (representing leadership/authority) as the source of wisdom and law, while portraying the common people as those who 'refuse to keep commandments and laws.' The text does not suggest superior intelligence among regular people; rather, it illustrates their difficulty in understanding and following even explicit guidance.
